text.p: Safeway Inc said Tuesday it had completed the acquisition of Vons Cos Inc.
Safeway will issue 1.425 shares of its common for each Vons share it does not alrady own.
The closing of the deal follows a Vons shareholder meeting at which eholders approved the transaction, which will make Vons a wholly-owned subsidiary of Safeway.
Safeway also said it had completed the repurchase of 32 million share from a partnership affiliated with Kohlberg Kravis Roberts and Co.
The stock was repurchased at $43 a share. The repurchase was financed with proceeds from new bank facilities.
Safeway on Thursday entered a new $3 billion credit agreement with a syndicate of 29 banks.
